main_text.l: 3. sing. fæm. Rad. סָבַב.
תְּסַבּוּ[?] circuibitis, תְּסַבֶּינָה[?] circuibunt, fut. Kal, 2. pl m. & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. סָבַב.
תָּסֹג amovebis, vel bit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָסַג apprehendit.
תִּסָּגֵר includeris, vel tur, Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. סָגַר.
תְּסֹבֵּב[?] circumdabit, vel bis, pro תְּסוֹבֵּב, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. vel 2. f. m. Rad. סָבַב.
תְּסוֹבְּבֶךָּ[?] circumdabis te, vel bit, נִי[?] me, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. סָבַב.
תָּסוּךְ unges, vel unget te, תְּסוּכִי unges te, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. f f. Rad. סוּךְ.
תְּסוּרוּ[?] recedetis, fut. Kal, 2 pl. m. R. סוּר.
תָּסִיג[?] amovebis, vel bit,
fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel
3. f f. Rad. נָסַג appre-hendit.
תַּסִּיעַ[?] transferes, vel ret, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָסַע.
תָּסִיר removebis, vel bit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. סִיר.
וַתְּסִיתֵנִי[?] & incitasti, vel vit me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. סִית[?].
תָּסֹךְ obteges, vel get, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. סָכַךְ.
תִּסְּכוּ[?] libabitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. נָסַךְ.
תִּסְכְּנִי[?] obteges me, vel get, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. סָכַךְ.
תְּסֻלָּה[?] æstimaberis, vel tur, fut. Pual, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. סָלָה[?].
תִּסְּף[?] colliges, (pro תֵּאָסֵף[?], vel תֵּאָסֵף,) fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. אָסַף.
תִּסָּפֶה[?] consumeris, vel tur,
fut.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks are small and partly blurred in the scan; every Hebrew word is marked [?] where I could not confirm the points letter by letter. The Hebrew in the running head is copied as "ת ס" on both pages. The first line of the left column is a fragment of an entry carried over from the previous page. The printed hyphen in "appre-" is kept.
